title: 11 Best Herbal Teas For Hangover
description: Matricaria chamomilla teas have been traditionally used to treat hangover ailments due to their soothing and anti-inflammatory properties. The apigenin and luteolin present in these teas help to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms such as headaches and nausea associated with hangovers. The bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and terpenoids, contribute to the anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects that aid in the recovery from hangover symptoms.
